hero.title: Angels Care Medical Centre
hero.subtitle: Providing critical round-the-clock emergency, maternal, and pediatric health-care responses inside the Kyaka II Refugee Settlement.

crisis.title: A Strained Ingress Landscape
crisis.subtitle: We address complex health indicators amidst heavy seasonal malaria outbreaks, trauma management, and pediatric dehydration.

metrics.title: Overcoming Isolation
metrics.subtext: Total population packed in Kyaka II settlement and the surrounding vulnerable host communities of Kyegegwa.

metrics.title: Extremely Strained Ingress
metrics.subtext: Supported by only 5 satellite outposts. Understaffed, distant, and deeply overwhelmed by numbers.

metrics.title: The Sick Rate Breakdown
metrics.subtext: Over 2% of the local population requires immediate medical attention daily. Medical demand far outweighs supply.

benefits.title: Dignified Health and Compassion
benefits.description: Our health centre runs on an inclusive care model. We treat health value as a fundamental human right, not a business asset.

cards.title: Subsidized Relief
cards.subtext: Pricing is subsidized to be at least 40% less than local private clinics to ensure accessibility for every family.

cards.title: Angels Care Pipeline
cards.subtext: All children and students inside Angels Care School receive free checkups, treatments, and immediate emergency care.

cards.title: Empowering Households
cards.subtext: Regular outreach programs on hygiene, disease prevention, and family planning build community immunity.

services.title: Comprehensive Healthcare Services
services.description: Click the tags below to filter clinic capabilities across specific medical domains and diagnostic fields.

cards.title: 24/7 Emergency Outpatient Care
cards.description: Continuous, round-the-clock emergency reception handling trauma triage, deep lacerations, fractures, and severe infections.

cards.title: Maternal Birthing Suites & Midwives
cards.description: Fully staffed obstetric wing with certified midwives overseeing deliveries, pre-natal care, and post-partum recovery beds.

cards.title: Pediatric Ward & Immunization
cards.description: Dedicated children's treatment ward addressing acute respiratory tracts, dehydration, and standard vaccination schedules.

cards.title: Malaria Diagnostic & Therapy
cards.description: Dedicated screening services and rapid clinical response therapy, combating the region's top source of childhood mortality.

cards.title: Fully Stocked Pharmacy
cards.description: In-house licensed dispensary supplying subsidized essential antibiotics, IV bags, pain relief, and maternal vitamins.

cards.title: Laboratory & Diagnostic Testing
cards.description: Rapid hematology laboratories performing slide microscopy, urine tests, HIV/TB tests, and custom diagnostics.

cards.title: Nutritional Therapy Unit
cards.description: Outpatient program serving severely malnourished infants with therapeutic peanut pastes (RUTF) and high-density milks.

cards.title: Basic Dental & Oral Health
cards.description: Basic dental hygiene education, treatment, and pain extraction services led by visiting dental professionals.

campaign.title: ACMC Infrastructure Upgrades
campaign.intro: While our operations are robust, we require target funding to construct specialized isolation units and acquire surgical-grade diagnostics:

equipments.label: Birthing Suites & Delivery Care Beds ($5,000 CAN)
Backup Clinic Diesel Generator (Solar Hybrid) ($8,000 CAN)

sidebar.title: Sponsor Clinic Equipment Today!
sidebar.text: Your designated donation supports Pastor Godfrey and our licensed clinical staff in procuring essential diagnostics and basic pharmaceuticals for refugees.
